[spoiler=The Nordiheim News]
The familiar news room of Nordiheim news comes up on the screen with the usualy news anchors, Jarli at the left and Asha to the right, sitting behind their large news desk.

Jarli is the one that starts the program today with the camera having him in its focus.
[i]Good evening viewers and welcome to todays Nordiheimian news.[/i]
He says with a smile as the screen behind them starts showing what is most likely a stock recording of workers at a dockyeard building a frigate.
[i]Today we start with some news about the Nordrlandi Shipyard company who have now been confirmed to be in the prosses of buidling two prototype hulls of the future Sif-class, there also seems to be ongoing dialoge and cordination with Nordiheim Arms company and other partners as to what weapons and systems will be installed in these two prototypes for future testing, such as the new Frigg weapon system.[/i]

The camera moves slightly to the side as Asha takes over.
[i]Though it isn't joust the Nordrlandi company that is buisy now adays, the other shipyard companies in all the coastal regions are reaching their maximum capacity as it seems that there is a lott of people that want new ships, and not only military ships, several ships have also been ordered to meet future demand for the shipping industry in the Argos strait including Gas tankers wich is proberly related to the diplomatic talks that have been done over in Tirakan.[/i]

The background swiches to show diplomat Bakir al-Aydin as he gets of a goverment marked airplane wich have most likely joust arived back in a Nordiheim airport.
[i]The diplomatic mission led by the respected Olian diplomat Bakir al-Aydin arived back in Nordiheim at the Midgard Internation Airport joust this morning to give the good news to the council that he had been successfull in re-establishing the old trade treaty from 1965 with only some minor changes.
Mr. Bakir also mentioned that Tirakan seemed interested in greater diplomatic dealings with nations in the Argos strait such as Nordiheim in the future wich some people belive would be great for the energy supply and stability in our region of the world.[/i]

[i]With Tirakan now being a propper democratic nation there is also not a national controvercy in Nordiheim over having a trade deal with them wich means people are generaly celebrating the success of the diplomatic move unlike how it was back in the 60s when it was anounced and it was mett with protests despite its benefits, aditionaly there is an agreement among economy experts that the access to Tirakan gas will benefit the Nordiheimian industry as it will prevent energy prices not only going up but might even make it go down slightly wich is good news for energy hungry factories.[/i]

Jarli takes over as the background starts showing a aerial view of a rather clean and new looking mining site.
[i]Speaking of the economy the secound mine of the Datia mining company opened joust last week joust before the first one more or less reached its full estimated extraction rate, wich is a good ting since the refineries in Midland have allready reached a intake capacity wich the first mine can not meet on its own.
With this also comes a noticable downturn in Aborias registered unemploymend rate as the mining company needs ever more workers, this combined with the housing market having fully stabilized in the region have made the aproval rating among the former Datians towards the goverment rise even higher then before, especialy in regards to their regional minister Chief Adoni.

Aditionaly there is good progress in the start of the phosphores mines in southern Sorland with both a mining plan and the entrance points for the mines having been agreed on, it seems that in an effort to not damage or destroy the farmland of the area they are going to go for fully underground mines instead of a "open pit" type.
While this will increase the operational cost of the endeavor it is still prognosed by even the more carefull estimates that it will be profittable, there is also the fact that this plan have been far more widely accepted by the local inhabitans who are mainly farmers and as such had many concearns regarding the mines potential inpact on the local soil quality, now that the mines are going to be in the rock under the soil these worries have been lessened though some do remain ofcorse.[/i]

The background screen changes to show a buissiness man talking to reporters outside a goverment building with a glass facade as Asha takes over the last part.
[i]The COE of NNMC piched the idea to the council about making enviromental safety a high priorety from the start of the mines creation, someting the council agreed with, as this would "future proof it" in regards to planed and potential future enviromental laws and regulations aswell as be much cheaper then to shoehorn it in at a later point with potential "clean up" costs that might become neceseary.
Some enviromentalists have called his foreshight in regards to the mines operation plan a pleasent surprice from an "industrialist", even if they stil don't like that a mine is to be opened.
That was all the news we had for this time.[/i]

The background screen changes into the logo of the Nordiheim news channel as the news program comes to an end.
[i]This have been Jarli, and Asha, with todays news and we hope to see you next time.[/i]
The channel then goes over into comersials.

[spoiler=Nordiheimian and Tiraki Renewed Trade and Resource deal of 2027]
[b]Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Kingdom of Tirakan[/b]
[align=center][i]==========================================[/i]

[i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Tirakan declare the renewal of their old trade agreement of 1965 that was interupted by unfortunate events.[/u][/i]
[i][u]_R_____E_____N_____E_____W_____A_____L_[/u][/i]
[u][b]Resource Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to open its markets of [b]Uranium[/b], [b]Gold[/b] and [b]Aluminium[/b] to Tirakan for them to buy these resources as they need.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] Tirakan agrees to open its markets of [b]Gas[/b] to Nordiheim for them to buy these resource as they need.

[b][u]1.c:[/u][/b] The quanteties and price of these resources will be ordered and delivered on a quarterly bassis based on fair market prices.

[u][b]1.d:[/b][/u] When Nordiheim gets it Phorsphores extraction industry working they agree to add this resource to the ones Tirakan are allowed to purchase after pre-existing agreements are satisfied.

++++++-----------++++++----------++++++
[u][b]Trade Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation any higher then 5% without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

++++++----------++++++----------++++++
[u][b]Other.[/b][/u]

[b][u]3:[/u][/b] In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Tirakan be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of the deal between the two nations as long as both parties can arrive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++----------++++++-----------++++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

[u][i]Main Shamat Diplomat Bakir al-Aydin of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]  +++++++  [u][i]Premier Arlan Vos of The Democratic Technocracy of Greater Tirakan[/i][/u][/spoiler]

[SPOILER=the squid artifact user][b]Janksi Hongeo[/b], user of the Musi-Olingeo, squid mujisang, a man with a white fur jacket, black hair like most of population, 25 years, golden chains pending from his neck, he was the captain of his crew, the [b]Janksi jaysunim,[/b] his first mate, Shong Ho wears similar clothing, with the difference being he uses a golden belt and no chains, while also wearing blue glasses.
As the crewa mob of a about 12 peoplearrived at the Cassino of Yeongmeyon  entrance, Janksi extended his hand in front of them, saying with a prideful smile.
All of you should stand backhe pointed his indicator finger to himselfI, the captain will make my entrance!
The crew cheerfully acepted, the musician however, grabbed his Captain's arm as he was preparing to launch himself.
Captain!He raised his face as Janksi slowly turned his head to his direction, the musician tried to warnC-captain, this is not a good idea to do in a so public space...many people do not know these powers nature...
Janksi however, simply frowned and took the arm of his musician of him then replied:
And i with that?
The first mate simply pulled him, and told.
You should not care with him, Janksi, he is a simply newcomer, he still needs to adapt, go ahead."
The captain seemed excited now without anyone stopping him, he prepared himself by inclining himself vertically, then yelled:
"SPRING HOPPER!" 
Then launched himself with great speed toward one of the cassino tables, where the people in there seemed surprised and highly get up from their chairs, the others around also looked to him.
Who the hell is this guy?
How he managed to do that?
I can not believe in what just happened!
Where among the many reactions, Janksi did not showed any care for their reactions, instead, simply lay down on the table and smiled to one of the tables where people were gaming, then made his way to there, the men betting defied:
You come here and scare everyone and then simply wants to play? Is that it?!
The captain simply nodded in agreement, then smiled with certain disdain contained.
Yes, exactly this old manHe then looked to everyone else in the cassinoThe name is Janksi Hongeo, i am a jaysunim who ate the musijang of Musi-Olingeo, the squid artifact.
As he introduced himself, his crew entered, he pointed to them saying:
And that is my crew!
However, one of the guards of security of the cassino grabbed his arm, Janksi seemed surprised, and a bit bothered, then looked back and said:
I do not belong to you, get off!
He took off his arm then glanced at the security with certain contempt, the member of security then ordered:
As much the government does not care about your powers, does not mean you can go on doing whatever you want.
Sessang-in Maeum Saeng-Gi, live life free, that is our main teaching! And i am doing this!
He tried to defend himself, but the guard replied.
Glad i do not follow any faith because for me this is simply showing off.
Shong Ho then arrived, he looked holding a laugh to his captain and the guard, then said to the security.
Leave him alone...perhaps you...He took of a wad of money from his coat and lend it to the guard.Maybe we can negotiate, we do not do this again here and you turn a blind eye for us.
The man accepted with a certain smile on his face, as he grabbed the money, a total of 600 Dao in money.
Yes, of course, but there will not be a next time.
The first mate then simply smiled as he saw the guard leave, his steps on the shining white floor were surprisingly light for a man of that size.
Now, let us play captain!
He grabbed Janksi despite everyone still looking with certain annoyance by the situation.
Absolutely!
He cheerfully accepted as he started to move on to the next table to play, and bet, the rest of the crew did the same, betting and betting, the people in the cassino slowly accepted their presence, still a certain wary about it.
LET US SEE WHO IS THE BEST DRINKER OF US JANK!
Shong challenged Janksi with his voice already altered due the alcohol, he was sit down on a bench of wood of the cassino drinking, the counter was made of shining white marble, with several bottles of drinks around it, the captain did accepted with a smile on his face and his back already a little curved.
HAH, you can not defeat me when it comes to drinking Shong!
He answered with arrogance in his voice, then grabbed a bottle from the counter and drinked it entirely without any cup.
Next one!
He ordered to the man serving the drinks.
The restaurant of the cassino was full of the Janksi crew, while the first and second in command drink in a competition, the other 10 were eating the good food which the waitresses were serving.[/spoiler]

[b]Trouble in the East: December 13th, 2026[/b]

[spoiler=This is about the Narcotics Trade in Koranvistan]Andrudin- The historical Eastern Jewel of Koranvistan- was a sprawling, winding maze of streets, parks, and alleyways. Covered in snow every October like clockwork, it was nestled at a high point in the north Elseyrian valleys. The city had seen the worst of the fighting during the revolution, having acted as the rebels bastion for over 9 months of grueling combat. Throughout early 2026, after the new regime secured a hard-won victory with the aid of several foreign powers ([b]OOC: Reply if you helped in the war, so far the only nation on the list is Corzerran[/b]), a great rebuild was taking place. Destroyed roads were re-routed for better traffic through the city, new businesses and shops were built, and new urban residences were constructed to bring people in. Andrudin slowly became a hub for economic activity once again, filled with working Koranvistanis and other nationals from Elseyr.

December was never a terrible month. Between the winter festivals and [i]Samurov[/i], a pagan holiday from early tradition, December was often a high point for the people. However, a time for gathering and celebration this year was, instead, a time of remembering what was lost the year before. Bars and nightclubs became havens for the tired and heartbroken. Drinks, empty entertainment, and of course: the black market. The drug trade was dominated, in the Orlov district at least, by the Sasanov Syndicate. The Sasanov Syndicate was a notorious crime family, with connections in and around Elseyr, Vespuria, and Western Shamat ([b]OOC: also reply or tg if you want connections with a crime family or smth idk[/b])

And although the Syndicate strives for product quality to keep returning customers, there are never any guarantees. Things slip through the cracks, tests arent properly administered, and problems arise. The first problem came on December 13th, when reporter Auggie Fritz published a story in the [i]Orlov Times[/i]. 13 people had died of suspected overdoses, 14 more were hospitalized. Fritz, in her article, took several statements from those willing and affected by, what seemed to be, contamination.

[i]I dunno what happened, I was doin my normal uh routine, as it was, and den I started seein alla dese spots in my eyes. It was like nothin Id nevah seen, an den I was atta hospital![/i] One anonymous person reported.

[i]I was handling. Nothing big, just a small-time sale every now and again. One of the bags tore open as I was sorting my stock, and I got enough on my hands to cause a problem. Theres no being safe with this, its a danger.[/i] A Syndicate member, also anonymous, spoke. [i]Nobodys okay with this. And if I can go on record here, dead isnt how we want a customer. Happy, a little numb, who cares. You get by how you get by. But this isnt right, and we are gonna get some.. Restitution, lets say, from whoever supplied this.[/i]

The Monarchy has yet to issue an official statement on the matter, but is ...hard at work in an attempt to prevent further issue.
[/spoiler]
